title: Moon Hub   Auto Farm, Egg, Raid, Boost, Meteor, infiltration
features:
# Moon Hub | Anime Warriors 3
## v1.0.5

### Farming & Gamemodes
- Auto Farm
- Auto Quest
- Auto Egg
- Auto Raid — Normal, Hard & Cursed
- Auto Escort
- Auto Infiltration
- Auto Invasion
- Auto Gauntlet
- Auto Meteors
- Auto Shovel — Summer Treasure Digging

### Shops & Boosts
- Auto Gauntlet Shop
- Auto Escort Shop
- Auto Infiltration Shop
- Auto Use Boosts
- Auto Pause & Unpause Boosts Outside Features

### Combat & Loadouts
- Auto Attack — configurable range & attack method
- Auto Click
- Auto Equip Best
- Auto Equip Sword
- Auto Collect Drops
- Auto Swap Team — Egg, Raid, Escort, Infiltration, Invasion & Gauntlet
- Auto Swap Accessories — Egg, Raid, Escort, Infiltration, Invasion & Gauntlet
- Per-Floor Team & Accessories Swap (Gauntlet)
- Teleport to Egg

### Gamemode Controls
- Difficulty Priority (Raids)
- Mode Priority (Gauntlet, Infiltration & Invasion)
- Tier Priority (Escort)
- Card Priority & Card Effects (Gauntlet)
- Auto Vote Cards & Auto Skip Wave (Invasion)
- Auto Floor 30 Skip (Gauntlet)
- Drop Farm — Smart Re-entry (Gauntlet)
- Auto Leave at Phase, Floor & Checkpoint

### Party System
- Auto Party Join — Raid, Escort, Gauntlet, Infiltration & Invasion
- Host & Alt Username Setup
- Delayed Backup Host
- Auto Delay by Party Order
- Smart Escort & Invasion Replay
- Wrong Lobby Recovery

### Rewards & Utilities
- Egg Webhook — Discord, filterable by rarity
- Hide Username
- Anti AFK
- Anti Gameplay Paused
- Auto Rejoin — with saved position
- Server Information & Options

### Performance
- Hide Effects
- Low Graphics Mode
- FPS Cap
- Auto FPS Mode

### Automation Systems
- Custom Priority System — all features
- Feature Status & Runtime Diagnostics
- Performance Monitor
- Save Return & Rejoin Position
- Config Saving & Loading — with Auto Load
- Theme & UI Settings
